method_note: Research done via web search + page fetch summaries (WebFetch returns model-summarised text, so some 'quotes' are summary strings rather than raw page text; flagged where so). Image-based prices converted assuming 1 frame/second sampling = 3,600 frames per video hour (our assumption, not vendor's).

entries.conversion_note: Not convertible: sold as subscription/enterprise contract, no per-hour unit published.

entries.accuracy_claim: Qualitative only: 'proprietary AI detects logos and signage at the asset level with high precision' (Japan launch press release). No numeric precision/recall found.

entries.name: Google Cloud Video Intelligence (logo + text detection)
entries.what_it_does: Stored-video logo detection and text (OCR) detection.
entries.price_text: Free first 1,000 min/month, then $0.15 per minute (logo and text); per-minute, partial minutes rounded up; discounts above 100,000 min/month via sales; $0.12-0.135 reported on a page variant (unconfirmed).
entries.conversion_note: $0.15 x 60 = $9.00/hr; x 100,000 = $900,000. At $0.12: $7.20/hr, $720,000. One detector only; both logo+text would double.

sources.quote: Text detection and Logo detection at Free for the first 1,000 minutes, then $0.15 per minute (search-result summary; direct fetch returned no table)

entries.caveats: Official page did not render via fetch; confirmation came from search summary of the official page.

entries.name: Amazon Rekognition (video labels / image DetectText / Custom Labels)
entries.what_it_does: Video label detection; image text detection (DetectText); Custom Labels for trainable logo/board detection.
entries.price_text: Video label detection $0.10/min; image Group 2 APIs (incl. DetectText) first tier $0.0010 per image (first 1M/month), lower tiers beyond; Custom Labels inference $4/hour, training $1/hour; streaming $0.00817/min.
entries.conversion_note: DetectText at 1 fps: 3,600 x $0.001 = $3.60/hr; x 100k = $360,000 (top-tier price; volume tiers lower, exact lower-tier rates not retrieved). Video labels $0.10 x 60 = $6.00/hr = $600,000 but that is label detection, not OCR/logo.

sources.quote: Label Detection: $0.10/min ... $0.0010 per image for the first 1 million images ... $4 per hour (summary of page)

entries.caveats: Fetch summarised; the 1 fps assumption is ours.

entries.conversion_note: $1.75 is the analysis-input lower bound; adding indexing $2.50 gives up to $4.25/hr = $425,000 per 100k; output tokens extra (unknown).

entries.name: Roboflow hosted inference
entries.price_text: Credit-based; docs estimate 0.2 credits per 1,000 images for RF-DETR Small (1 credit = 500 s inference). Dollar per credit not on official page fetched; third-party summaries say ~$4 monthly / ~$3 annual.
entries.conversion_note: 3,600 frames = 3.6 x 0.2 = 0.72 credits x ~$4 = $2.88/hr; x 100k = $288,000. Credit price is third-party; model-specific estimate; cold starts 2.2 credits/1,000.
entries.caveats: Requires you to train your own model; training cost/labelling excluded.
